Hero.headline: Discover the heritage of scripts and inscriptions
Hero.lede: Photograph an inscription, read its letters, and document its meaning in seconds.

How.title: From carved stone to clear meaning
How.copy: Abjadi guides you from the photo to documenting the inscription — recognizing ancient letters and translating them into modern Arabic.
How.captureCopy: Point the camera and place the letters inside the frame.
How.captureAlt: Abjadi home screen for capturing text
How.scanCopy: Prepares the image and detects the text region and letters.
How.scanAlt: AI text analysis screen while scanning
How.readCopy: It recognizes the letters and shows the translated text.
How.readAlt: Analysis result with discovered letters and meaning
How.archiveCopy: Save the inscription with location, script type, and language.

Process.title: AI that reads with you
Process.copy: From preparing the image to recognizing letters and translating the text — step by step.
